<!--
Shared look of the QC and Details reports, matching the Master Summary
(modules/scratch/MASTER_SUMMARY): cosmo theme and left TOC (set in each notebook's YAML),
the interactive-figures note, Master Summary table styling, and its plot palette and
left-aligned titles as the default Plotly / matplotlib style.
-->

<style>
  /* Compact tab buttons (many per-patient / per-sample tabs). */
  .panel-tabset .nav-link {
    font-size: 0.9rem !important;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem !important;
  }
  .panel-tabset .nav-link.active { font-weight: 600; }
  /* Tables styled like the Master Summary's reactable tables. */
  .cell-output-display table {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .cell-output-display table thead th {
    background: #f7f7f8;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  }
  .cell-output-display table td,
  .cell-output-display table th { padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; }
  .cell-output-display table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #fafafa; }
</style>

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Most figures in this report are interactive.** Hover a point or bar for exact values, drag
to zoom, double-click to reset, and click legend entries to show or hide series.
:::

```{python}
#| include: false
import matplotlib as _mpl
import plotly.graph_objects as _go
import plotly.io as _pio

# Master Summary palette and layout (pal / ttl in _ms_setup.qmd).
_REPORT_PALETTE = ["#2c7fb8", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77",
                   "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02", "#a6761d"]
_pio.templates["tcrtoolkit"] = _go.layout.Template(layout=dict(
    font=dict(family='"Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif',
              size=13, color="#373a3c"),
    title=dict(x=0, xanchor="left", font=dict(size=16)),
    colorway=_REPORT_PALETTE,
))
_pio.templates.default = "plotly_white+tcrtoolkit"

_mpl.rcParams.update({
    "axes.prop_cycle": _mpl.cycler(color=_REPORT_PALETTE),
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.titlelocation": "left",
    "font.size": 11,
})
```
